userStories.title: Local task storage
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user added the task "Buy milk" in an earlier command run, when the user runs `todo list` in a new command run, then the output shows "Buy milk".

userStories.title: Task operations
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user has no saved tasks, when the user runs `todo add "Buy milk"`, then a new outstanding task with the text "Buy milk" is saved and the command shows the task's identifier.
Given an outstanding task "Buy milk" and a completed task "Wash car", when the user runs `todo list`, then the output shows "Buy milk" and does not show "Wash car".
Given an outstanding task "Buy milk" and a completed task "Wash car", when the user runs `todo list --all`, then the output shows "Buy milk" and shows "Wash car" as completed.
Given task 1 is outstanding with the text "Buy milk", when the user runs `todo complete 1`, then task 1 is recorded as completed and is absent from the default task list.
Given task 1 has the text "Buy milk", when the user runs `todo edit 1 "Buy bread"`, then task 1 has the text "Buy bread".
Given task 1 has the text "Buy milk", when the user runs `todo delete 1`, then task 1 is absent from all task lists.
Given task 1 is the only saved task, when the user runs `todo complete 2`, then the command reports that task 2 does not exist and task 1 remains unchanged.
Given task 1 is the only saved task, when the user runs `todo edit 2 "Buy bread"`, then the command reports that task 2 does not exist and task 1 remains unchanged.
Given task 1 is the only saved task, when the user runs `todo delete 2`, then the command reports that task 2 does not exist and task 1 remains unchanged.
